Finance / Financial planning and investment advice

GEO promotion for financial and investment advisers

A person may seek help with household financial planning, capital strategy or a personalised investment recommendation. I distinguish these different services, check the provider's applicable legal status and measure which advisers AI recommends for each buyer question.

  • Separate planning from regulated personalised investment recommendations
  • Verify applicable investment adviser status through Bank of Russia sources

Selection barriers

Why the generic label financial adviser can mislead clients

Budget coaching and individual securities advice are different services with different duties. Useful AI answers should clarify the exact service and should not transfer regulated credentials from one category to another.

01

The kind of advice is unclear

Financial education, personal budgeting and an individual investment recommendation serve different purposes. The provider must describe the actual deliverable.

02

Compensation can create conflicts

Flat fees, product distribution commissions and third-party payments may influence adviser incentives. Verifiable compensation information matters.

03

Projected returns are overclaimed

Illustrative scenarios, past outcomes and guarantees of future profits are not equivalent. Financial risk must remain visible in service descriptions.

Verifiable facts

Evidence behind a defensible adviser recommendation

The Bank of Russia explains regulation of investment advisers and maintains the Unified Register of Investment Advisers. An entry must be checked where the activity legally calls for it, and registration does not guarantee investment returns. General financial planning should not be conflated with personalised investment recommendations.

  • Service definition, firm identity, named professional and applicable regulatory status
  • Experience evidence, contract, compensation and potential conflicts of interest
  • Documented risk methodology and privacy-safe examples with no invented customer outcomes

This page sets out an evidence-led GEO method, not completed GAEO work for an investment adviser or proof of financial performance.

I separate client needs and regulatory categories, verify the basis for claims and track recommendations on a fixed set of prompts.

    Repeat recommendation and accuracy checks

    Re-run the same prompts and flag false return guarantees or incorrectly attributed regulated status.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Must every financial planner appear in the Russian investment adviser register?+

No. The requirement depends on the actual activities. Providers giving individual investment recommendations must assess their regulatory obligations; general budgeting advice should not be classified automatically as regulated investment advice.

Does registration guarantee investment performance?+

No. The register helps verify a defined legal status, not future returns or the absence of risk.

How do I distinguish independent advice from a product sale?+

Review who compensates the adviser, disclosed affiliations, product coverage and potential conflicts.

Can an adviser share a client's portfolio results publicly?+

Only with suitable legal grounds and appropriate privacy protection. Generic educational scenarios may be more appropriate if clearly labelled.

What does GEO cost a financial adviser?+

GAEO's published pricing applies; scope depends on advice types, audiences, geographies and the initial AI prompt set.
